title: Dirac's theorem on Hamiltonian cycles
statement: Let $G$ be a finite simple graph on $n$ vertices, where $n \ge 3$, and suppose every vertex has degree at least $n/2$ (equivalently, $n \le 2\delta$, where $\delta$ denotes the minimum degree of $G$). Then $G$ is Hamiltonian, that is, $G$ contains a cycle passing through every vertex exactly once.
